restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes. The complete hash is unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 1 prefix round in the single root compression: standard IV, counter 0, block length 64, flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT = 11, and the first 32 little-endian root-output bytes.

The algorithm is the straight-line inversion in the proof. It fixes the public constants C0 = 2 and D0 = 5, computes both messages from the standard IV, and returns them. It draws no random words, runs no search, and calls no compression.

Correctness is the substitution proof that both digests are the 32-byte zero string and that the first message words differ. Success probability is 1 on that single execution. There is no restart and no heuristic.

Word-RAM accounting expands each 32-bit rotation into two shifts, one OR and one mask, masks 32-bit subtraction chains as specified, and charges lane packing plus four 256-bit stores. C = 222. The counted program is 475 primitives and the submitted time_log2 is the upper bound 1.30.
baseline_improved names the nominal display reference blake3-r1-nominal-v2. It is not an established attack or a qualified baseline. data_log2 is omitted. Nonuniform advice is empty.
